tweaks.name: Windows Game Mode
tweaks.description: Let Windows prioritize your game and reduce interruptions during play.
tweaks.note: Uses the Windows Game Mode preference. Results depend on workload.

tweaks.name: Background game recording
tweaks.description: Turn off background capture when you do not need gameplay recordings.
tweaks.note: Disables app capture. Existing recordings are kept.

tweaks.name: Consistent mouse movement
tweaks.description: Disable Enhance pointer precision for a predictable desktop pointer response.
tweaks.note: Sign out and back in to apply. Games with raw input usually ignore this preference.

tweaks.name: Reduce transparency
tweaks.description: Use opaque Windows surfaces to reduce visual effects.
tweaks.note: A visual preference; no FPS improvement is guaranteed.

tweaks.name: Advertising ID
tweaks.description: Stop apps from using your Windows advertising ID for personalized ads.
tweaks.note: Does not disable Windows security, updates, or required diagnostic data.

tweaks.name: Suggested content
tweaks.description: Reduce suggested content in the Windows Settings app.
tweaks.note: Windows-version dependent. This preference may be reset by feature updates.

tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: See full file names in Explorer so file types are easier to identify.
tweaks.note: Reopen Explorer windows to see the change.

tweaks.name: Reduce taskbar animations
tweaks.description: Simplify taskbar motion for a quieter desktop.
tweaks.note: Sign out and back in to apply. Availability varies with Windows build.

tweaks.name: Faster menu opening
tweaks.description: Set the desktop menu display delay to 200 milliseconds.
tweaks.note: Sign out and back in to apply. This changes menu timing, not game latency.

tweaks.name: High performance power plan
tweaks.description: Prefer performance over power savings using the built-in Windows plan.
tweaks.note: Higher power use, heat, and battery drain. Only available when the plan exists on this PC.
